<style>
/* ============================================================================
   MUSEU EM FIOS — design system (formato sections)
   Identidade: Estúdio Agudo · Implementação: Vitamina Publicitária

   Este arquivo é o nosso: tokens, tipografia e todos os componentes autorais
   (.mf-*, .obra-card, .guia-card, o grafismo do fio). Não depende de classe
   nenhuma do tema base — atravessa a migração inteiro.

   A reestilização dos componentes DA PLATAFORMA (grade, botões, header,
   footer, produto) mora em museu-ponte.css, que é o arquivo a refazer
   contra as classes do Ipanema.
============================================================================ */
/* Fontes self-hosted (variáveis, subset latin — cobre PT-BR).
   Licença: SIL Open Font License. */
:root {
  /* Cores base */
  --preto: #1d1d1b;
  --branco: #ffffff;
  --papel: #fbfaf6;

  /* Cores auxiliares (pinçadas das obras) */
  --amarelo: #f2c440;   /* Klimt — Der Kuss */
  --verde: #9cad4e;     /* Monet — Le Pont Japonais */
  --azul: #6a9cc3;      /* Monet — Femme à l'ombrelle */

  --cinza: #6f6f6a;
  --linha: rgba(29, 29, 27, 0.16);

  /* Tipografia */
  --f-titulo: "Inter", -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --f-texto: "Roboto Serif", Georgia, serif;

  /* Ritmo */
  --mf-gutter: clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem);
  --mf-secao: clamp(4.5rem, 10vh, 8.5rem);

  --transicao: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- reset -- */
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--papel);
  color: var(--preto);
  font-family: var(--f-texto);
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.68;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
}

img { max-width: 100%; display: block; height: auto; }
a { color: inherit; }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; background: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; }

::selection { background: var(--amarelo); color: var(--preto); }

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- helpers -- */
.mf-wrap { width: min(100% - 2 * var(--mf-gutter), 1440px); margin-inline: auto; }
.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px;
  clip-path: inset(50%); overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Tipos */
.mf-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}
.mf-eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  width: 2.25rem; height: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
}

.mf-display {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  line-height: 0.92;
  text-transform: none;
  margin: 0;
}

.mf-h2 {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(2.1rem, 4.6vw, 3.9rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 1.02;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
}

.mf-serif {
  font-family: var(--f-texto);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.6vw, 2.1rem);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.mf-italic { font-style: italic; }

/* Botões */
.mf-btn {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.75rem;
  background: var(--preto);
  color: var(--branco);
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--preto);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: color 0.35s var(--transicao);
}
.mf-btn::after { content: "→"; transition: transform 0.35s var(--transicao); }
.mf-btn:hover::after, .mf-btn:focus-visible::after { transform: translateX(0.3rem); }
.mf-btn--claro { background: transparent; color: var(--preto); }
.mf-btn--claro:hover { background: var(--preto); color: var(--branco); }
.mf-btn--branco { background: var(--branco); color: var(--preto); border-color: var(--branco); }

.mf-link {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
}
.mf-link::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 1.5px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.4s var(--transicao);
}
.mf-link:hover::before { transform: scaleX(0.55); }
.mf-link::after { content: "→"; }

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2.5px solid var(--preto);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Grafismo: fio/linha hexagonal do manual */
.fio { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; overflow: visible; }
.fio path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--preto);
  stroke-width: 1.5px;
}
.fio--branco path { stroke: var(--branco); }

/* Reveals (JS marca como pronto; sem JS tudo fica visível) */
.mf-js .mf-reveal { opacity: 0; }
.mf-js .mf-reveal.is-in { opacity: 1; }

/* ================================================================ header -- */
.mf-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 60;
  background: var(--papel);
  transition: box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}
.mf-header.is-scrolled { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--preto); }

.mf-header__inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding-block: 1.1rem;
  transition: padding 0.3s ease;
}
.mf-header.is-scrolled .mf-header__inner { padding-block: 0.7rem; }

.mf-logo { display: inline-flex; text-decoration: none; }
.mf-logo img, .mf-logo svg { height: 54px; width: auto; transition: height 0.3s ease; }
.mf-header.is-scrolled .mf-logo img, .mf-header.is-scrolled .mf-logo svg { height: 42px; }

.mf-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem); }
.mf-nav a {
  font-family: var(--f-texto);
  font-size: 1.04rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
}
.mf-nav a::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 1.5px;
  background: var(--preto);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform 0.35s var(--transicao);
}
.mf-nav a:hover::after, .mf-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

.mf-header__acoes { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.4rem; }
.mf-carrinho {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
.mf-carrinho__count {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem;
  padding-inline: 0.3rem;
  background: var(--amarelo);
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.mf-menu-btn { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .mf-nav {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--amarelo);
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1.6rem;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    transform: translateY(-102%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.5s var(--transicao), visibility 0s 0.5s;
    z-index: 70;
  }
  .mf-nav.is-open { visibility: visible; transition: transform 0.5s var(--transicao); }
  .mf-nav a { font-size: 1.7rem; }
  .mf-nav.is-open { transform: translateY(0); }
  .mf-menu-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    z-index: 80;
    padding: 0.4rem 0;
  }
  .mf-menu-btn span {
    width: 26px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--preto);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;
  }
  .mf-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
  .mf-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .mf-menu-btn[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }
}

/* ================================================================== hero -- */
.mf-hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: min(92vh, 60rem);
  display: grid;
  overflow: clip;
  background: var(--cor-hero, var(--azul));
  transition: background-color 0.9s ease;
}

/* Visibilidade dos slides 100% via CSS (classe .is-active) — o GSAP anima
   só os filhos. Evita estados órfãos quando o navegador suspende a aba
   (overlap de textos visto no iPadOS). */
.mf-hero__slide {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  padding: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem) var(--mf-gutter);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease, visibility 0s linear 0.5s;
}
.mf-hero__slide.is-active {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.15s;
}

.mf-hero__descritor {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.1rem;
  inset-inline: 0;
  z-index: 6;
  text-align: center;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  padding-inline: var(--mf-gutter);
  margin: 0;
}

.mf-hero__intro {
  max-width: 36ch;
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 1.4rem 0 0;
  justify-self: start;
}
.mf-hero__intro .pergunta {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.mf-hero__ficha {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.13em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.8;
  align-self: flex-end;
}

.mf-hero__palco {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding-block: 1rem;
}
.mf-hero__obra {
  position: relative;
  width: min(46vh, 78vw, 30rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.mf-hero__obra img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

.mf-hero__fio {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%; top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: min(66vh, 96vw, 46rem);
  aspect-ratio: 1.3;
}

.mf-hero__nome {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  text-align: center;
  font-size: clamp(4.5rem, 17vw, 15rem);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}
.mf-hero__nome .char { display: inline-block; }

.mf-hero__rodape {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
}
.mf-hero__kit {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 3.2vw, 2.6rem);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 0.95;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
}

.mf-hero__nav {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: clamp(1.2rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  z-index: 5;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.mf-hero__dot {
  width: 2.4rem;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 0;
  background: none;
  position: relative;
}
.mf-hero__dot::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 21px 0;
  background: rgba(29,29,27,0.3);
}
.mf-hero__dot .prog {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 21px 0;
  background: var(--preto);
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
}
.mf-hero__dot.is-active .prog { transform: scaleX(1); }

@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .mf-hero { min-height: 88vh; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; }
  /* No celular o descritor quebra em 2-3 linhas: sai do absoluto e entra no
     fluxo do grid (linha própria acima do slide) pra nunca cobrir o intro. */
  .mf-hero__descritor { position: static; grid-area: 1 / 1; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
  .mf-hero__slide { grid-area: 2 / 1; }
  .mf-hero__rodape { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  .mf-hero__nav { position: static; margin: 0.75rem 0 1.5rem; padding-inline: var(--mf-gutter); }
}

/* =============================================================== marquee -- */
.mf-marquee {
  background: var(--preto);
  color: var(--papel);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding-block: 0.9rem;
  border-block: 1.5px solid var(--preto);
}
.mf-marquee__trilho {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: mf-marquee 36s linear infinite;
}
.mf-marquee__trilho span {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 900;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3.5rem;
}
.mf-marquee__trilho span::after { content: "✳"; font-weight: 400; }
@keyframes mf-marquee {
  to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mf-marquee__trilho { animation: none; }
}

/* ============================================================= manifesto -- */
.mf-manifesto {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: var(--mf-secao);
  overflow: clip;
}
.mf-manifesto__fio {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -18% -6%;
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.mf-manifesto .mf-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  max-width: 62rem;
}
.mf-manifesto__frase {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3.4rem);
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.mf-manifesto__frase .palavra { display: inline-block; }
.mf-manifesto__apoio {
  max-width: 44ch;
  margin: 0;
  justify-self: end;
  text-align: left;
}

/* ================================================================ a noite -- */
/* O layout "quebra" pra noite: gradiente do papel pro céu noturno e de volta.
   É o momento de uso do produto — o vídeo institucional mora no escuro. */
.mf-noite {
  --ceu: #10131d;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--papel) 0%,
    #434a5c 9%,
    var(--ceu) 26%,
    var(--ceu) 78%,
    #434a5c 93%,
    var(--papel) 100%
  );
  color: var(--papel);
  padding-block: clamp(8rem, 16vw, 14rem);
  text-align: center;
}
.mf-noite .mf-eyebrow { color: var(--amarelo); }
.mf-noite .mf-h2 { margin-inline: auto; }
.mf-noite__apoio {
  max-width: 52ch;
  margin: 1.5rem auto 0;
}
/* O player, grande: quase a largura toda do wrap no desktop e sangrando
   até as bordas da tela no mobile — o tamanho é pedido do cliente. */
.mf-noite__video {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 80rem;
  margin: 3.5rem auto 0;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  background: #000;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(251, 250, 246, 0.18);
  box-shadow: 0 32px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}
.mf-noite__video iframe {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
}
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .mf-noite__video {
    margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--mf-gutter));
    border-inline: 0;
  }
}

/* ================================================================ vitrine -- */
.mf-vitrine { padding-block: var(--mf-secao); }
.mf-vitrine__topo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.mf-grade {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(20rem, 100%), 1fr));
  gap: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 2.25rem);
}

.obra-card {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  background: var(--cor-card, var(--azul));
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}
.obra-card[data-cor="amarelo"] { --cor-card: var(--amarelo); }
.obra-card[data-cor="verde"] { --cor-card: var(--verde); }
.obra-card[data-cor="azul"] { --cor-card: var(--azul); }
.obra-card[data-cor="papel"] { --cor-card: #edeae0; }

.obra-card__img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 12% 14% auto;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.obra-card__img img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.7s var(--transicao);
}
.obra-card:hover .obra-card__img img { transform: scale(1.05); }

/* Foto real do kit bordado: revelada no hover (obra → interpretação em fios) */
.obra-card__img .foto-real {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s var(--transicao), transform 0.7s var(--transicao);
}
.obra-card:hover .obra-card__img .foto-real,
.obra-card:focus-visible .obra-card__img .foto-real { opacity: 1; }

.obra-card__fio { position: absolute; inset: 6% 5%; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; }
.obra-card:hover .obra-card__fio { opacity: 1; }

.obra-card__artista {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  top: 46%;
  z-index: 2;
  text-align: center;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 900;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1;
  font-size: clamp(3rem, 7.5vw, 4.6rem);
  margin: 0;
}

.obra-card__base {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.4rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  z-index: 3;
}
.obra-card__obra {
  margin: 0;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.obra-card__tipo {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}
.obra-card__preco {
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  text-align: right;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.obra-card__preco del {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.obra-card__cta {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  background: var(--preto);
  color: var(--papel);
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  transform: translateY(101%);
  transition: transform 0.45s var(--transicao);
}
.obra-card:hover .obra-card__cta,
.obra-card:focus-visible .obra-card__cta { transform: translateY(0); }

.obra-card--breve .obra-card__img { filter: grayscale(0.85); opacity: 0.75; }
.obra-card__selo {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.1rem; left: 1.1rem;
  z-index: 5;
  background: var(--preto);
  color: var(--papel);
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
}
.obra-card__selo--oferta { background: var(--branco); color: var(--preto); }

/* Guias digitais */
.mf-grade--guias {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(14rem, 100%), 1fr));
}
.guia-card {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--linha);
  background: var(--branco);
  transition: border-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.4s var(--transicao);
}
.guia-card:hover { border-color: var(--preto); transform: translateY(-4px); }
.guia-card__img { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; overflow: hidden; background: #f1efe8; }
.guia-card__img img {
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 0.6s var(--transicao);
}
.guia-card:hover .guia-card__img img { transform: scale(1.05); }
.guia-card__info { display: block; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 1.3rem; }
.guia-card__tipo {
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--f-titulo);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--cinza);
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}
.guia-card__nome {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.02rem;

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
if (window.gsap && window.ScrollTrigger) {
/* ============================================================================
   MUSEU EM FIOS — camada de interação e motion
   Tema Nuvemshop — GSAP + ScrollTrigger (vendorizados). Degrada com segurança:
   sem JS ou com prefers-reduced-motion o conteúdo fica 100% visível e usável.
============================================================================ */

(function () {
  "use strict";

  var reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  var hasGsap = typeof window.gsap !== "undefined";
  var gsap = window.gsap;
  if (hasGsap && window.ScrollTrigger) gsap.registerPlugin(window.ScrollTrigger);

  var EASE = "power3.out";

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ utils -- */

  function $(sel, ctx) { return (ctx || document).querySelector(sel); }
  function $$(sel, ctx) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((ctx || document).querySelectorAll(sel)); }

  /* Divide um texto em <span class="char"> preservando acessibilidade */
  function splitChars(el) {
    var text = el.textContent;
    el.setAttribute("aria-label", text);
    el.textContent = "";
    text.split("").forEach(function (ch) {
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "char";
      s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      s.textContent = ch === " " ? " " : ch;
      el.appendChild(s);
    });
    return $$(".char", el);
  }

  function splitWords(el) {
    var text = el.textContent.trim();
    el.setAttribute("aria-label", text);
    el.textContent = "";
    text.split(/\s+/).forEach(function (w, i) {
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "palavra";
      s.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      s.textContent = w;
      el.appendChild(s);
      el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" "));
    });
    return $$(".palavra", el);
  }

  /* Grafismo do manual: duas metades abertas de hexágono alongado.
     Gerado em coordenadas de pixel do container para o traço e o
     "desenho" da linha (dashoffset) ficarem exatos. */
  function fioPaths(w, h) {
    return [
      "M " + 0.60 * w + " " + 0.02 * h + " L " + 0.96 * w + " " + 0.28 * h + " L " + 0.96 * w + " " + 0.78 * h,
      "M " + 0.04 * w + " " + 0.22 * h + " L " + 0.04 * w + " " + 0.72 * h + " L " + 0.40 * w + " " + 0.98 * h
    ];
  }

  function injectFio(el) {
    var w = el.clientWidth || 300;
    var h = el.clientHeight || 300;
    var svg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "svg");
    svg.setAttribute("class", "fio" + (el.getAttribute("data-fio") === "branco" ? " fio--branco" : ""));
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + w + " " + h);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    svg.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    fioPaths(w, h).forEach(function (d) {
      var p = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
      p.setAttribute("d", d);
      svg.appendChild(p);
    });
    el.appendChild(svg);
    return svg;
  }

  /* Prepara um path para "desenhar" (dashoffset) */
  function drawPaths(svg, opts) {
    if (!hasGsap) return;
    var paths = $$("path", svg);
    paths.forEach(function (p) {
      var len = p.getTotalLength();
      p.style.strokeDasharray = len;
      p.style.strokeDashoffset = reduced ? 0 : len;
    });
    if (reduced) return;
    gsap.to(paths, Object.assign({
      strokeDashoffset: 0,
      duration: 1.4,
      ease: "power2.inOut",
      stagger: 0.15
    }, opts || {}));
  }

  /* ----------------------------------------------------------- header -- */

  function initHeader() {
    var header = $(".mf-header");
    if (!header) return;
    var update = function () {
      header.classList.toggle("is-scrolled", window.scrollY > 24);
    };
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    update();

    var btn = $(".mf-menu-btn");
    var nav = $(".mf-nav");
    if (btn && nav) {
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var open = nav.classList.toggle("is-open");
        btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
        document.documentElement.style.overflow = open ? "hidden" : "";
      });
      $$("a", nav).forEach(function (a) {
        a.addEventListener("click", function () {
          nav.classList.remove("is-open");
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          document.documentElement.style.overflow = "";
        });
      });
    }
  }

  /* --------------------------------------------------------- carrinho -- */

  /* Carrinho: o fluxo real é do Layout Base (ajax_cart). Aqui só o CTA
     de WhatsApp do produto, com a mensagem pré-preenchida. */

  function initWhatsApp() {
    $$(".js-museu-wa").forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var msg = a.getAttribute("data-message");
        var base = a.getAttribute("href");
        if (!msg || !base) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        var sep = base.indexOf("?") === -1 ? "?" : "&";
        window.open(base + sep + "text=" + encodeURIComponent(msg), "_blank", "noopener");
      });
    });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- hero -- */

  function initHero() {
    var hero = $(".mf-hero");
    if (!hero) return;
    var slides = $$(".mf-hero__slide", hero);
    if (!slides.length) return;
    var dots = $$(".mf-hero__dot", hero);
    var atual = 0;
    var timer = null;
    var DURACAO = 6500;

    /* Prepara nomes e fios */
    slides.forEach(function (slide) {
      var nome = $(".mf-hero__nome", slide);
      if (nome && hasGsap && !reduced) splitChars(nome);
      var alvoFio = $(".mf-hero__fio", slide);
      if (alvoFio) injectFio(alvoFio);
    });

    function mostra(i, primeira) {
      var anterior = slides[atual];
      atual = (i + slides.length) % slides.length;
      var slide = slides[atual];

      hero.style.setProperty("--cor-hero", "var(--" + (slide.getAttribute("data-cor") || "azul") + ")");

      slides.forEach(function (s, j) { s.classList.toggle("is-active", j === atual); });
      dots.forEach(function (d, j) {
        d.classList.toggle("is-active", j === atual);
        d.setAttribute("aria-pressed", j === atual ? "true" : "false");
        var prog = $(".prog", d);
        if (prog && hasGsap) {
          gsap.killTweensOf(prog);
          gsap.set(prog, { scaleX: j === atual ? 0 : 0, transformOrigin: "left" });
          if (j === atual && !reduced) gsap.to(prog, { scaleX: 1, duration: DURACAO / 1000, ease: "none" });
          if (j === atual && reduced) gsap.set(prog, { scaleX: 1 });
        }
      });

      if (!hasGsap || reduced) return;

      /* A troca de slide é do CSS (classe .is-active); o GSAP anima apenas
         os filhos do slide ativo — nunca a visibilidade do slide em si. */
      var chars = $$(".char", $(".mf-hero__nome", slide) || slide);
      var obra = $(".mf-hero__obra img", slide);
      var intro = $(".mf-hero__intro", slide);
      var rodape = $(".mf-hero__rodape", slide);
      var fio = $(".mf-hero__fio .fio", slide);

      gsap.killTweensOf([chars, obra, intro, rodape]);

      var tl = gsap.timeline({ delay: primeira ? 0 : 0.2 });
      if (obra) tl.fromTo(obra, { scale: 1.12 }, { scale: 1, duration: 1.6, ease: EASE }, 0);
      if (chars.length) {
        tl.fromTo(chars,
          { yPercent: 60, autoAlpha: 0 },
          { yPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: EASE, stagger: 0.045 }, 0.15);
      }
      if (fio) drawPaths(fio, { delay: 0.2 });
      if (intro) tl.fromTo(intro, { y: 24, autoAlpha: 0 }, { y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: EASE }, 0.3);
      if (rodape) tl.fromTo(rodape, { y: 24, autoAlpha: 0 }, { y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: EASE }, 0.4);
    }

    function agenda() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      if (slides.length < 2 || reduced) return;
      timer = setInterval(function () { mostra(atual + 1); }, DURACAO);
    }

    dots.forEach(function (d, j) {
      d.addEventListener("click", function () { mostra(j); agenda(); });
    });
    hero.addEventListener("mouseenter", function () { clearInterval(timer); });
    hero.addEventListener("mouseleave", agenda);
    hero.addEventListener("focusin", function () { clearInterval(timer); });
    hero.addEventListener("focusout", agenda);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
      if (document.hidden) {
        clearInterval(timer);
      } else {
        mostra(atual);
        agenda();
      }
    });

    mostra(0, true);
    agenda();
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- reveals -- */

  function initReveals() {
    if (!hasGsap || !window.ScrollTrigger) return;

    $$("[data-reveal]").forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.add("mf-reveal");
      var alvos = el.getAttribute("data-reveal") === "grupo" ? Array.prototype.slice.call(el.children) : [el];
      gsap.fromTo(alvos,
        reduced ? { autoAlpha: 0 } : { autoAlpha: 0, y: 34 },
        {
          autoAlpha: 1,
          y: 0,
          duration: reduced ? 0.2 : 0.85,
          ease: EASE,
          stagger: reduced ? 0 : 0.09,
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: "top 86%", once: true },
          onStart: function () { el.classList.add("is-in"); }
        });
    });

    /* Fios que se desenham ao entrar na tela */
    $$("[data-fio]").forEach(function (el) {
      if ($(".fio", el)) return; /* hero já injetou */
      var svg = injectFio(el);
      if (reduced) return;
      window.ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: el,
        start: "top 82%",
        once: true,
        onEnter: function () { drawPaths(svg); }
      });
    });

    /* Manifesto: palavras sobem uma a uma */
    var frase = $(".mf-manifesto__frase");
    if (frase && !reduced) {
      var palavras = splitWords(frase);
      gsap.fromTo(palavras,
        { yPercent: 110, autoAlpha: 0 },
        {
          yPercent: 0, autoAlpha: 1,
          duration: 0.7, ease: EASE, stagger: 0.035,
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: frase, start: "top 80%", once: true }
        });
    }

    /* Parallax sutil nas obras dos cards e seções */
    if (!reduced) {
      $$("[data-parallax] img").forEach(function (img) {
        gsap.fromTo(img, { yPercent: -6 }, {
          yPercent: 6,
          ease: "none",
          scrollTrigger: { trigger: img, scrub: 0.6 }
        });
      });
    }
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- produto -- */

  function initProduto() {
    var qtd = $(".mf-qtd");
    if (qtd) {
      var input = $("input", qtd);
      $$("button", qtd).forEach(function (b) {
        b.addEventListener("click", function () {
          var v = parseInt(input.value, 10) || 1;
          v += b.getAttribute("data-passo") === "-" ? -1 : 1;
          input.value = Math.max(1, Math.min(99, v));
        });
      });
    }

    var palco = $(".mf-produto__palco img");
    $$(".mf-produto__thumbs button").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        $$(".mf-produto__thumbs button").forEach(function (x) {
          x.classList.remove("is-active");
          x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
        });
        b.classList.add("is-active");
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
        if (!palco) return;
        var src = b.getAttribute("data-img");
        if (hasGsap && !reduced) {
          gsap.to(palco, {
            autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.18, onComplete: function () {
              palco.src = src;
              gsap.fromTo(palco, { autoAlpha: 0, scale: 1.04 }, { autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: EASE });
            }
          });
        } else {
          palco.src = src;
        }
      });
    });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ loja -- */

  function initFiltros() {
    var botoes = $$(".mf-filtro");
    if (!botoes.length) return;
    var cards = $$("[data-artista]");
    botoes.forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        botoes.forEach(function (x) { x.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false"); });
        b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");
        var alvo = b.getAttribute("data-filtro");
        cards.forEach(function (c) {
          var mostra = alvo === "todos" || c.getAttribute("data-artista") === alvo;
          c.style.display = mostra ? "" : "none";
        });
        if (window.ScrollTrigger) window.ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      });
    });
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------- cursor com fio -- */

  function initCursor() {
    if (reduced) return;
    if (!window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches) return;

    var dot = document.createElement("div");
    dot.className = "mf-cursor";
    document.body.appendChild(dot);

    var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
    canvas.className = "mf-fio-canvas";
    document.body.appendChild(canvas);
    var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    function resize() {
      canvas.width = window.innerWidth * devicePixelRatio;
      canvas.height = window.innerHeight * devicePixelRatio;
      ctx.setTransform(devicePixelRatio, 0, 0, devicePixelRatio, 0, 0);
    }
    resize();
    window.addEventListener("resize", resize);

    var alvoX = -100, alvoY = -100, x = -100, y = -100;
    var pontos = [];
    var MAX = 32;

    document.addEventListener("mousemove", function (e) {
      alvoX = e.clientX; alvoY = e.clientY;
    });

    document.addEventListener("mouseover", function (e) {
      dot.classList.toggle("is-link", !!e.target.closest("a, button, [role='button'], summary"));
    });

    function frame() {
      x += (alvoX - x) * 0.22;
      y += (alvoY - y) * 0.22;
      dot.style.transform = "translate(" + x + "px," + y + "px) translate(-50%,-50%)";

      pontos.push({ x: x, y: y });
      if (pontos.length > MAX) pontos.shift();

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      if (pontos.length > 2) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(pontos[0].x, pontos[0].y);
        for (var i = 1; i < pontos.length - 1; i++) {
          var mx = (pontos[i].x + pontos[i + 1].x) / 2;
          var my = (pontos[i].y + pontos[i + 1].y) / 2;
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pontos[i].x, pontos[i].y, mx, my);
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------- boot -- */

  function init() {
    if (hasGsap) document.documentElement.classList.add("mf-js");
    initHeader();
    initWhatsApp();
    initHero();
    initReveals();
    initProduto();
    initFiltros();
    initCursor();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

} else {
  console.warn('Museu em Fios: GSAP não carregou; o motion fica desligado.');
}
});
</script>
